full_query: What is the most safe amount of Advil to take at one time

shared_context.topic: safe amount of Advil to take at one time

sentences: The safest amount of Advil (ibuprofen) to take at one time, for an adult, is 400 mg
This dosage is generally effective for pain relief and is the standard over-the-counter dose

It is important to not exceed this amount unless directed by a healthcare provider, as higher doses can increase the risk of adverse effects such as gastrointestinal bleeding, kidney damage, and cardiovascular issues
